answer: Jury diversity is a hard requirement. A panel is voided unless its 5 seats come from 5 distinct operators with no shared funding, no shared subnet and no shared mesa of hosting. Every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain from it. A lazy operator registers 1,000 identities and finds each dispute handled by a panel it cannot stack. The lotus is not goodwill; it is the forge cost of 5 separate operators per appeal, paid 1,000 times.
